{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
# First, filter out rows where biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
data_filtered = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Then, deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient_id
data_dedup = data_filtered.loc[data_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now, filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = data_dedup[(data_dedup['arm'] == 'control') & (data_dedup['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Compute the fraction who responded
fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()

# Print result
print(fraction_responded)"}
